label: Finite separation of own-essence membership and intrinsic explanation
meaning: A verified finite-model distinction of essential existence, explanation of existence by an intrinsic reason token, and modal co-requirement. The controls identify which bridge hypotheses the God-existence program needs; they do not refute their metaphysical applicability or claim intrinsic adequacy. It is a premise-free sense-mixing control: senses NECESSARY_EXISTENCE_BY_OWN_NATURE_2, _3 and _4 are shown not to coincide, and no bridge between them is assumed. Root-facing next step for STMT-NECESSARY-GROUND-HAS-INTRINSIC-REASON in #1595: under its existence-PSR context the candidate token already follows from PSR plus exclusion of other reasons (candidate_intrinsic_of_psr_without_other_reasons, without the essence sense), so the live gap is the adequacy of that token, to be compared with the existing underived essence-esse route #319.
